title: Sidebar beads: two-line rows styled like bd list
description:
Render each bd-ready bead in the sidebar as TWO lines, echoing bd list's row style:

  ○ cmdr-keen-gu3 ● P4
    Placeholder: second demo bead

Line 1: bd status circle (○ open — the only status bd ready emits today, but map ◐ in_progress / ● blocked / ✓ closed / ❄ deferred defensively), the issue id, and a priority badge ('● P4') colored by priority. Line 2: the title, faint, indented under the id.

No bd-status legend in the sidebar (the circle is self-explanatory). Layout math (BeadRowsToShow / showLegend) must account for 2 rows per bead.
close_reason: Shipped: two-line bd-list-style sidebar rows (landed in 2e8a786) + bd list polling. Closing also demos a bead dropping off the sidebar.

comments.author: Jeff Dwyer
comments.text: Implemented: two-line bd-list-style rows (status circle + id + priority badge / faint title), layout math at beadStride=2, badge drops before the id truncates. Tests green (TestRenderBeadRowTwoLines, TestBeadsToShow, TestShowLegendYieldsToBeads). Commit held: render.go/layout.go currently share uncommitted tab-outline work from a parallel session.
